**Issue #3958 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3958: Patch: the inbox's Play and Open look like buttons, Home's bookmarks are 44 pixels across, and the Play hub shows its Solo row at 1280×720
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

A follow-up to the Play hub and inbox (#3729, merged in #3902) and the app shell (#3728, merged in #3750), found in their device-size screenshots. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

- **Inbox, every size:** the daily rows' Play and Open read as highlighted words, not buttons, though each is the row's one action. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3729-play-inbox/inbox-1180x820-ipad-landscape.png))
- **Home, every touch size:** the Quests and News bookmarks are 36×54, short across of the brief's 44×44 (spec 47's `hitAreaProblems`). ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3728-shell/home-820x1180-ipad-portrait.png))
- **Play hub, desktop 1280×720:** the Solo cards are cut to their titles at the window's bottom, and the Replays and Friends links are out of view in the hub's scroll region, with nothing to show there is more. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3729-play-inbox/play-1280x720-desktop.png))

All shots: https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3902#issuecomment-6892253299 and https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3750#issuecomment-6892216580.

### What should happen

At every device size in #3726: an inbox row's action looks and sizes like the theme's other buttons, at least 44×44 on touch. Home's bookmarks are at least 44 px in both directions on touch. At 1280×720 the Play hub shows every section's cards, or makes clear the rest is below: the cards tighten at short heights, or a fade or cue shows the region scrolls.

### Where

`apps/web/src/inbox/InboxPanel.tsx` and `inbox.css`; `apps/web/src/routes/PlayHub.tsx` and `play-hub.css`; Home's bookmarks under `apps/web/src/shell/` or `apps/web/src/routes/` (grep `Quests`).

### Tests

Checks that fail without the fix: the inbox rows' actions and Home's bookmarks pass `hitAreaProblems` at the touch sizes, in the specs that already render them at `MENU_SIZES` (spec 56 for the inbox, spec 51 for Home). Keep the existing hub and inbox tests passing.

I'll take the device-size screenshots for the pull request once it merges.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43699772315)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Fix three layout defects from #3958. (1) The inbox's daily-row Play and Open links look like highlighted words, so they get the button size and shape, at least 44 px tall. (2) Home's Quests and News bookmarks become at least 44 px across and 44 px or more tall on touch. (3) At 1280×720 the Play hub tightens its cards at short heights and shows a cue that its scroll region has more below. Cypress specs 47 and 56 get checks that fail without the fix.

**Findings from reading the code**
- `InboxBell.tsx` portals the panel into `document.body` under `<div className="tavern lobby together-screen inbox-layer">`, which is not inside `.app-shell`.
- The button sizing for `a.button-primary` lives in `index.css` (`.app-shell a.button-primary`) and `auth/tavern.css` (`.tavern.app-shell … a.button-primary`). Neither reaches the inbox, so the `<a>` links get only the gold skin from `buttons.css`, with no padding or radius. That is why they read as highlighted words.
- Home's bookmarks are `width: 36px; height: 54px` in `apps/web/src/routes/landing.css` (about line 534). The News ribbon sits at `left: 66px` (22 + 36 + 8 gap).
- The inbox and Play hub specs named in the issue are different from the real ones. The hit-area measure `hitAreaProblems` lives only in `e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts`, which runs `MENU_SIZES` with touch emulation. Spec 57 is the inbox spec and only renders request rows. Spec 51 does not measure hit areas.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/inbox/inbox.css` | `change`: size rule for the row's action links and buttons |
| `apps/web/src/routes/landing.css` | `change`: bookmark width 36→44 px, News ribbon `left` 66→74 px, comment |
| `apps/web/src/routes/play-hub.css` | `change`: short-height tightening and a bottom scroll cue on `.play-body` |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts` | `change`: two signed-in tests per size (Home bookmarks, inbox with daily rows) |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/56-play-hub.cy.ts` | `change`: one test per size that the hub shows the Solo cards or a cue |

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/`, `spec/` or any `.tsx` component. No ruling is needed (no rules decision), and no catalog or patch fragment (UI only). Governing notes: spec 47's hit-area rule (R2122000), the menu sizes (R3728000), the Play hub (R3729000, R1578000, R1581000), the inbox (R3729002), the bookmarks (R2035000, R2875002) and the button roles (`buttons.css`, #3219).

## Steps

1. **`apps/web/src/inbox/inbox.css`**: append this block at the end, with a comment explaining that the panel is portalled outside `.app-shell`, so the shell's button sizing never reaches it:
   ```css
   .inbox-row .together-row__actions :is(a, button) { min-height: var(--hit-min); }
   .inbox-row .together-row__actions a {
     display: inline-flex;
     align-items: center;
     justify-content: center;
     box-sizing: border-box;
     padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-7);
     border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
     font-weight: 700;
     text-decoration: none;
   }
   ```
   - This is layout only. `buttons.test.ts` bans colours, backgrounds and borders on the roles in other sheets, so do not set any here.
   - The `a.button-primary` skin still comes from `buttons.css`.
   - The `a` rule has weight (0,2,1) and `button-primary` in `buttons.css` has (0,1,0), so no skin competes.

2. **`apps/web/src/routes/landing.css`**, bookmark rule (about line 523):
   - Change `width: 36px;` to `width: 44px;`. Leave `height: 54px`. It is above 44 and `::before` fills it with `inset: 0`.
   - In the News rule `.landing .landing-quests ~ .landing-news button.landing-news-bookmark`, change `left: 66px;` to `left: 74px;`.
   - Update the comment above it to "22px in, 44px wide".
   - `.landing-news-count` is positioned inside its button, so it needs no change.

3. **`apps/web/src/routes/play-hub.css`**:
   - In `.tavern.play-screen.play-hub > .play-body`, add `position: relative;` and `padding-bottom: var(--space-9);`. This gives the cue room at the end of the scroll.
   - Add a cue pseudo-element after that rule. It is a sticky fade at the region's foot that never takes layout room or taps. The `margin-top` pulls it back over the flex `gap`.
     ```css
     .tavern.play-screen.play-hub > .play-body::after {
       content: "";
       flex: 0 0 auto;
       position: sticky;
       bottom: calc(var(--space-9) * -1);
       height: var(--space-9);
       margin-top: calc(var(--space-9) * -1 - var(--space-6));
       background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--pal-black) 55%, transparent));
       pointer-events: none;
     }
     ```
     - If the sticky bottom offset misbehaves, use `bottom: 0` and keep the padding. The aim is a dark fade over the region's last 24 px while there is more below.
   - Add a progressive enhancement that fades the cue out at the end of the scroll, because a cue that never goes away reads as dimming:
     ```css
     @supports (animation-timeline: scroll()) {
       .tavern.play-screen.play-hub > .play-body::after {
         animation: play-body-cue linear both;
         animation-timeline: scroll(self);
         animation-range: 85% 100%;
       }
       @keyframes play-body-cue { to { opacity: 0; } }
     }
     ```
     - A region that does not scroll has no scroll range. The fade is then inert and the cue stays, which is a dim band over the bottom padding. Acceptable, but if the builder sees it at 1440×900, add `@media (min-height: 900px) { …::after { display: none; } }`.
   - Short-height tightening goes at the end of the file:
     ```css
     @media (min-width: 601px) and (max-height: 800px) {
       .tavern.play-screen.play-hub .play-cards { gap: var(--space-6); }
       .tavern.play-screen.play-hub .play-group { gap: var(--space-3); }
       .tavern.play-screen.play-hub .play-group__heading { font-size: var(--type-lg); }
       .tavern.play-screen.play-hub .play-group__cards { gap: var(--space-4); }
       .tavern.play-screen.play-hub .play-card { padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-6); }
       .tavern.play-screen.play-hub .play-hero .brand__word { font-size: var(--type-3xl); }
     }
     ```
     - Check that `--type-lg` and `--type-3xl` exist in `typescale.css` (`grep -- '--type-lg' apps/web/src/typescale.css`). Substitute the nearest existing step if one does not.
     - All values must be tokens (`spacing.test.ts`, `palette.test.ts`).
     - The tightening alone will not fit four groups at 720 px, so the cue is the guarantee.
     - Do not use `:has()` (`hasSelectors.test.ts`).

4. **`e2e/cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts`**: add imports at the top. `inboxTestid` comes from `../../../apps/web/src/inbox/testids.ts` (`landingTestid` is already imported from `auth/testids.ts`). Then add these inside `describe("signed in", …)` for each size, after the `/play` test:
   - **Home test.** `it("R2122000 R2035000 /, the quests bookmark", …)`:
     - `cy.visitAs(SIGNED_IN(), routes.landing());`
     - `cy.get(ts(landingTestid.questsBookmark), { timeout: timeouts.view }).should("be.visible");`
     - `expectHitAreas(size);`
     - This assumes the free account `SIGNED_IN` (p2) has quests, so the bookmark renders. If it is absent, find what the Home shot in `51-menu-shell.cy.ts` relies on and mirror it.
   - **Inbox test.** `it("R2122000 R3729002 the inbox, a daily move and a daily challenge", …)`:
     - Before `cy.visitAs`, add `cy.intercept("GET", "**/api/daily", { body: DAILY_LIST })`. `DAILY_LIST` is a module constant matching the `DailyList` type in `apps/web/src/net/daily.ts`:
       - `games`: one `DailyGameSummary`, with `matchId` a v4-UUID-shaped string, `mode: "random"` (read `DailyMode` in the same file for the valid values), `perMoveDays: 1`, `seat: "p1"`, `opponent: { profileId, username: "Rival" }`, `portraits: { me, them }` (copy valid `PortraitId`s from `apps/web/src/net/daily.ts` or a daily test fixture), `turn: 1`, `life: { me: 30, them: 30 }`, `hasMove: true`, `theirMove: false`, `deadline: null`, `over: false`, `result: null`, `endedAt: null`, `createdAt: 0`.
       - `challenges.incoming`: one `DailyInvite` (`id`, `kind: "challenge"`, `from: { profileId, username: "Friend" }`, `to: null`, `mode`, `perMoveDays: 1`, `expiresAt` far in the future, `createdAt: 0`).
       - `challenges.outgoing: []`, `seeks: []`, `waiting: 1`.
     - Then `cy.visitAs(SIGNED_IN(), routes.collection());`, click `cy.get(ts(inboxTestid.bell), { timeout: timeouts.view })`, and wait for `ts(inboxTestid.play)` and `ts(inboxTestid.open)` to be visible.
     - Finish with `expectHitAreas(size);`. `controlsOf` measures only inside the open modal, so this measures the panel.
     - Check `daily/order.ts` (`sections`) for what makes a game "your move" (`hasMove && !over`) and an incoming challenge, and adjust the fixture to it.
     - Keep the request count low. The `SIGNED_IN` comment warns about R109's per-minute allowance, so if it starts returning 429s use `SPARE()` for the inbox test.

5. **`e2e/cypress/e2e/56-play-hub.cy.ts`**: add a test inside the per-size loop (the one with `describe("screenshots at …")`, or a new `describe` beside it), `it("R3729000 the hub shows its Solo cards or a cue that more is below", …)`:
   - `cy.visitAs(ACCOUNT(), routes.play()); cy.get(ts(PLAY_HUB))` is visible.
   - Then `cy.get(".play-body").should(($body) => { … })`. Compute from `$body[0]` that either `scrollHeight <= clientHeight + 1`, or `getComputedStyle($body[0], "::after").content` is not `"none"` and its `height` is above 0.
   - Also assert `$body` has `overflow-y: auto`, and that the Solo group's `[data-group="solo"]` card is either fully inside `$body`'s rect or the cue holds.
   - Use `playGroupTestid` if the spec already imports it, otherwise the `data-group` attribute selector.

## Tests

- **Web unit tests for the CSS rules** (they read the stylesheets, so they catch token and selector mistakes): `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/buttons.test.ts src/spacing.test.ts src/palette.test.ts src/hasSelectors.test.ts`. Add `src/inbox/InboxBell.test.tsx` and `src/routes/play.test.tsx` as the existing hub and inbox tests that must stay green.
- **E2E typecheck and lint:** `pnpm exec eslint e2e` and the e2e typecheck (check the `e2e` package script, usually `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck`).
- **Cypress:**
  - Spec 47 needs `E2E=1 pnpm --dir apps/web dev` and `E2E=1 cargo run --release -p jackioh-server` running. Run it with `cd e2e && pnpm exec cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/47-tap-areas.cy.ts`, which is a smoke spec in CI.
  - Spec 56 is daily-only. Run it with the same server and `--spec cypress/e2e/56-play-hub.cy.ts` if time allows.
  - If Cypress cannot run here, say so and do not claim the new tests pass.
- **Without the fix,** the Home test fails with "landing-quests-bookmark: its hit area is 36.0x54.0 px, short of 44 px across". The inbox test fails on "inbox-play"/"inbox-open" for the shortfall.

## Done when

- [ ] The inbox's Play and Open have button padding, radius and a min height of `--hit-min`, and pass `hitAreaProblems` at every size (`inbox.css`, step 1).
- [ ] The Quests and News bookmarks are 44 px wide, the News ribbon moved to 74 px, and Home passes `hitAreaProblems` (`landing.css`, step 2).
- [ ] At 1280×720 the hub tightens at short heights and shows a cue that it scrolls (`play-hub.css`, step 3).
- [ ] The new spec 47 and spec 56 tests are written, and the builder reports honestly which ones were run.
- [ ] The web unit tests above, plus the eslint and typecheck runs, are green.
- [ ] The harness checks pass (fmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests).

## Risks

- **Sticky cue.** A sticky pseudo-element inside a flex-column scroller can add height or sit wrong. Verify the `margin-top` and `bottom` in a built client (`ui-walkthrough` skill at 1280×720 and 1440×900), and confirm that it does not cover the Replays/Friends links at the scroll end. Its `pointer-events: none` stops it taking taps.
- **Spec 46** holds each menu to one screen. The cue and padding live inside `.play-body`, which is already the scroller, so the page height does not change.
- **Bookmark width.** The wider ribbon moves the News ribbon 8 px right. Check Home at 390 px that the News ribbon does not collide with the doors' box. Its `left` is relative to `.landing-news`.
- **CSS test sheets.** The sheets reject non-token colours, so use only `var(--pal-*)` colours and `color-mix`.
- **Cypress fixture.** It must match the `DailyList` type exactly, or the inbox shows nothing and the test hangs.

## Open questions

- None that block the work.
- The issue names spec 56 (inbox) and spec 51 (Home) for the checks, but `hitAreaProblems` exists only in spec 47 and spec 57 is the inbox spec. The plan therefore puts the hit-area checks in spec 47, which runs at every `MENU_SIZES` with touch and is part of the PR smoke run. It rates as medium: UI and CSS only, five files.
````
